scoring_justification: The artifact contains only the final computed quantities; a full recompute (T1) would require re-running all DFT calculations, which is not feasible in the verifier and not required by the output contract. The checker compares each reported value to the paper's Table I with per-quantity tolerances and verifies qualitative adsorption-site trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for adsorption energies E_ad (eV), height distortion Δh (Å), bond length d_ac (Å), and magnetic moment M (μ_B) for all atom/site combinations from the paper's Table I.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I as printed in J. Appl. Phys. 107, 114311 (2010); values cited in the conclusion_text and the paper markdown.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact transcription of the published numerical values; no transformation or synthesis applied.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported reference values that a correct DFT reproduction should recover within tolerances.

outputs.description: Contains the computed adsorption energy E_ad (eV), graphene height distortion Δh (Å), adsorbate–carbon bond length d_ac (Å), and total magnetic moment M (μ_B) for each combination of group-IVA atom (C, Si, Ge, Sn, Pb) and adsorption site (T, B, H).

output_contract.notes: Only the numerical values in this JSON file are scored; DOS and spin-density figures are not required. The checker compares the agent's reported values to the paper's published reference using per-quantity tolerances and also verifies qualitative adsorption-site trends.

steps.trend_rules: For C and Si: E_ad(B) < E_ad(T) < E_ad(H). For Ge, Sn, Pb: |E_ad(T) - E_ad(B)| <= 0.05 eV and max(E_ad(T), E_ad(B)) < E_ad(H).
